body:
P0 contingency implementation checkpoint (read-only; no edits before 00:05Z). Proposed smallest coherent shape, all embed-core and no receipt.scala/privacy.scala:

- No attempt rendering change/version bump. AttemptReceipt.of validates every EmbeddingReceipt.isKeyConsistent and exact providerCalls == embeddingReceipts.map(_.call); invalid combinations are refused, so the existing call checksums remain the nested cryptographic commitment.
- A private immutable owned-key snapshot becomes AttemptReceipt digest authority (Plain | Keyed(snapshot) | Withheld(missing)); addResultDecisions rebuilds directly under the same authority, so a post-call key withdrawal cannot erase calls or change kind.
- AttemptReceipt.failClosed removes providerCalls/embeddingReceipts parameters and always constructs both empty; of refuses a missing-key Withheld if any call provenance is present.
- SensitiveKeyProvider.static clones at capture as well as read. CachingEmbedder gets the requested mutable-alias adversarial test.
- LocalBaseline also snapshots before vectorFor; a batch containing non-public material with no usable key fails before computation, and the old once-key test becomes a stable-Keyed proof. This is necessary for the addendum: otherwise its current post-computation fallback still fabricates a call-free Withheld history.

Laws: mismatched call/embedding receipt refused; missing-key attempt with call provenance refused; every Withheld has both vectors empty; mutable-array mutation mid-cache batch cannot change cache/attempt identity; baseline once-key stays Keyed and call-preserving. If you want the LocalBaseline portion deferred despite the provenance hole, say so before handoff; otherwise I will implement this exact shape after 00:05Z.
